fix_subject: Fix trailing '%' wildcards ignoring the ESCAPE character
pr_title: The loop that consumes trailing '%' wildcards at the end of a LIKE

labels.summary: LIKE's trailing-'%' loop treated an escaped '%' as a wildcard, so 'abc' LIKE 'abc%%' ESCAPE '%' returned true, and a dangling escape at the end of the pattern raised a syntax error only when the string had characters left, so the error depended on the data.
